_comment: The calibre release this fork's Python is built against. src/calibre must be the same tag; the installers below are wrapped, never rebuilt. Digests are the GitHub release's own (gh release view vX -R kovidgoyal/calibre --json assets).
_archive: Upstream deletes a release's GitHub assets when the next release ships (9.14.0's vanished the day 9.15.0 came out). download.calibre-ebook.com/<version>/ keeps every version, so it is tried first and GitHub second; the sha256 above guards the bytes either way.
_mirror: Our own copy of each upstream release's installers, published by packaging/upstream-mirror.py as the pre-release upstream-<version> in this repository (daily, .github/workflows/zen-upstream-mirror.yml). The package scripts try it before the archive and GitHub, so a build no longer depends on upstream keeping old files or on one server being up.
